title: Tuning a PID controller
intro: A controller drives a lightly damped plant (it rings on its own) with a short dead time. At 0.5 s the setpoint steps from 0 to 1. Tune the three gains so that the output overshoots by less than 10 %, settles within 2 % of the setpoint in less than 2 s, and has no steady-state error.
uTitle: What the controller asks of the plant
checkTs: The output settles in less than 2 s.
